statements.t: Management anticipates continued revenue growth as the Company builds on its fourth-quarter operating recovery.
We anticipate continued revenue growth as we build on this recovery and remain focused on improving financial and operating performance.”
Management expects continued revenue growth as Mobix Labs builds on its fourth-quarter operating improvements and pursues opportunities across its aerospace, defense and mission-critical markets.

The Company’s preliminary fourth-quarter revenue exceeded the upper end of its previously announced guidance range, building on its earlier announcement anticipating more than 100% sequential revenue growth.
The Company expects to report its final fiscal 2026 financial results in its Annual Report on Form 10-K.
